title: Sell Mineral Rights in Pierce, CO
metaTitle: Sell Mineral Rights in Pierce, CO | North Weld Wattenberg Ground
metaDescription: Own minerals near Pierce, CO north of Greeley? We check Wattenberg field well density here before quoting your interest against actual production.
heroLead: Pierce sits a short drive north of Greeley, agricultural ground that's transitioned into steady Wattenberg field development over the past decade and a half.
intro: Small-town Weld County life around Pierce has run alongside farming, and mineral rights here typically stayed in family hands through generations of wheat and cattle operations even as the surrounding oil and gas industry grew up around them. Development density near Pierce sits comfortably inside the productive Wattenberg core, meaning most sections have seen at least one round of horizontal drilling.

sections.heading: What's likely producing under your ground
paragraphs: Standard Wattenberg field targets apply here: Niobrara B and C benches with a Codell tail, drilled on multi-well pads spaced across 640- or 1280-acre units. Given the timeline of development in this part of Weld County, a lot of Pierce-area wells are now several years into their decline curve, past the initial steep drop and settling into longer-term stripper production.
That maturity is useful for valuation purposes — a well with eight or ten years of production history gives a much more reliable decline trend to work from than a fresh completion.

sections.heading: What we need to quote your interest
paragraphs: Your deed or legal description, plus recent division order statements if you have them. We match everything against COGCC well and production records for the specific unit tied to your acreage.

faqs.question: How mature is drilling around Pierce compared to Greeley?
faqs.answer: Similar timeline overall, since both sit inside the core Wattenberg trend. Individual well age still varies section by section, which is what we check before quoting.

faqs.question: My royalty check has been shrinking every year — is that expected?
faqs.answer: Yes, that's the standard decline pattern for Niobrara horizontals. We value your interest against its current stage, not an old peak year.

faqs.question: Can I sell just my interest in one well while keeping others?
faqs.answer: Yes, if your acreage sits in multiple units, we can structure a sale around a specific well or unit rather than everything at once.

faqs.question: How quickly can I get a quote for a Pierce-area interest?
faqs.answer: Usually within a few days of receiving your legal description or deed, since well-documented Wattenberg field production history is generally easy to pull from COGCC records.

faqs.question: Do you handle interests owned jointly by several family members?
faqs.answer: Yes, we regularly work with co-owned interests and can either quote each owner's share individually or coordinate one combined transaction, whichever the family prefers.
